resources.string: Restart System Launcher to load update

Version %1$s updates System Launcher’s native library (.so). Other scopes already refreshed via API 102 hot reload, so you do not need to reboot your phone — restarting System Launcher once is enough.

Only System Launcher (com.miui.home) loads KeiHome’s native .so library. Hot reload cannot replace a library already mapped into that process, while Java hooks in System Framework, SystemUI, Themes, and other scopes are already up to date.

Tap “Open Launcher app info” below and choose Force stop (or restart System Launcher via LSPosed), then return Home to load the new native library right away. Reboot your phone only as a fallback if a specific ROM still keeps the previous build.
Confirming only dismisses this reminder — it will not stop System Launcher, reboot your phone, or change your layout and settings. This notice appears once per native-library update.
